name: dumbbell drag bicep curl
description: A curl where the dumbbells travel up close to your torso, dragging along your body. It keeps tension on the biceps and limits shoulder swing.
instructions: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in each hand, palms forward.
Pull your elbows back slightly and curl the weights up, keeping them close to your body.
Squeeze your biceps at the top without letting your elbows drift forward.
Lower the dumbbells slowly along the same path.
Keep your torso still and avoid swinging.
